name: Madness
desc: Extreme circumstances — the psychic assault of an aberration, a demonic curse, the raw truth of an elder evil — can strain a character's sanity beyond ordinary fear. A creature that succumbs makes a Wisdom or Charisma saving throw as set by the GM; on a failure it is afflicted with madness for a duration the effect specifies. Short-term madness lasts 1d10 minutes, long-term madness lasts 1d10 × 10 hours, and indefinite madness persists as a new flaw until cured. Effects range from being stunned or frightened to compulsive behaviours, hallucinations, and shifts in personality. A calm emotions spell suppresses madness; lesser restoration ends short-term or long-term madness, and greater restoration or a remove curse or dispel evil effect can lift indefinite madness depending on its source.
